name: Localization quick links
description: On-page tool for faster interface and configuration translation, surfaced from the toolbar.
project_description:
On-page tool for faster interface and config translation. It tracks interface strings and fields on the current page. The module is heavily inspired by the Localization client project which does not work (yet) for Drupal 8.

 Features 

 
 Tracks on page strings and entity fields rendered on the current page.
 A widget appears at the bottom of the viewport with a quick search, toggled by the 'Translate page' button in the toolbar.
 All strings are links and open either the locale translation ui with the selected string, or the list of translations for the selected field.
 Configuration at admin/config/regional/translate/l10n-quick-links to disable the widget on certain pages and track entity type fields with sensible defaults.
 
 The main reason this is a separate project is because my front end skills aren't perfect to finalize the D8 patch at [#2575401]. We are aware it is more or less a duplicate, but we needed something quickly working, hence, this project.
